note: This repo is a static Astro site, not a React component library. Per user decision (2026-07-21), the sync ships design tokens, fonts, and authored brand guidelines only — no component bundle. The .astro components (Navigation, Hero, Breadcrumb, ServiceCard, Footer) cannot execute in the design runtime and are intentionally not synced. Do not run the converter (package-build.mjs) against this repo.
